requiredBeforeSigning: Confirm this is the intended treasury/governance address
Confirm the address is deployed on Base if it is meant to be a Safe
Verify Safe owners and threshold using the official Safe interface

postExecutionChecks: Read owner() from the token and confirm it equals the intended new owner
Record the transaction hash in deployments/base-mainnet.json
Confirm the former owner can no longer call onlyOwner functions
Do not renounce ownership until governance and incident response are finalized
security: Never commit or share private keys, seed phrases, or signer secrets.
